Connor — quick note.

Thanks for flagging. A couple of suggestions before you rebook externally:

1) Have Rishi do a 15-minute pass on the two redline docs and highlight non-starters vs. negotiable language so the meeting doesn't get bogged down in clauses.
2) Send a one-page summary (bullet list) of the 5 priority items we want to close in the call — that helps procurement drive decisions.
3) Offer two concrete windows and indicate we're open to a shorter 30-minute focused call if they prefer.

Rishi — can you review the attached (Acacia_Redlines_2026-09-27.docx) and return notes by EOD? I'll standby to join if this escalates into legal back-and-forth.

Connor — ping me the chosen slot once they confirm; I'll be on the invite.

Thanks for the quick touch. Per Laura's note we've done a short legal pass and pulled the five items we'd like to close on first: data retention, audit logs (SOC access), private deployment encryption, indemnity cap language, and SLA remedies. Attaching the two redline files for reference.

To move forward today, can you confirm one of these slots?

- Fri 2026-10-02, 10:00–10:30 PT (30m focused)
- Mon 2026-10-05, 09:30–10:00 PT (short wrap)

Appreciate it — want to keep this moving so your rollout dates don't slip.
